meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. These are counts of unverified complaints that vehicle owners filed with NHTSA, kept for research and marketing planning. A complaint is not a finding that a vehicle is defective, and a count says nothing about whether any owner has a lemon-law or injury claim. Rights and deadlines are for your own counsel.
